request:
Simplify PR synchronization to normal Git lease semantics

## Problem

`sync_pr` currently performs multiple layers of race and retry reconciliation around one branch update:

- read Pull Request metadata
- check the current API head SHA
- read the branch again with `ls-remote`
- compare several accepted states
- push with an exact `force-with-lease`
- read Pull Request metadata again after the push
- preserve special in-process state so a later retry can recognize a push that may already have succeeded

The actual requirement from #10 is narrower:

> Do not overwrite unexpected external changes to the Pull Request branch.

Git already provides the primitive needed for that requirement: an exact `force-with-lease` compare-and-update.

The additional before/after reconciliation largely anticipates ambiguous timeout/race cases that have not been demonstrated as requiring this complexity.

## Expected outcome

Simplify `sync_pr` around normal Git lease semantics.

Conceptually:

```text
known remote head
  ↓
git push --force-with-lease=<exact-known-head>
  ↓
success or Git rejection
```

Retain only the metadata needed to identify the correct repository, branch, and expected head.

Remove duplicate remote-head checks, speculative post-push verification, and special retry reconciliation unless a concrete observed failure demonstrates that they are necessary.

External branch changes must still never be overwritten: the exact lease remains the authoritative guard.

## Context

The guiding principle is:

> Use the underlying system's existing concurrency primitive before adding a second reconciliation protocol around it.

If an ambiguous successful-push/failed-response case becomes a real operational problem, solve that case separately with the smallest necessary change.


Observed validation problem to address while updating the same synchronization regression tests: PR57 CI run35494567885 failed test_atomic_lease_rejects_race_after_remote_check at TemporaryDirectory cleanup with OSError39 Directory not empty: remote/.git on Python3.14. Another CI run of the same artifact passed. Diagnose the concrete cause as part of updating this lease test for #38; retain a real leased-push race regression. Keep any test fixture stabilization narrow; do not mask cleanup errors or restore runtime Git policy overrides. Read-only GitHub checks/logs are authorized. The earlier PR8 sync also failed post-push API verification although the exact pushed commit was present afterwards. Do not add a new reconciliation protocol.

User directive: GitWeave implements, creates a separate PR, reviews/fixes iteratively and merges only when clean. Stop on unsupported operations or permission/allowance limits and ask the user. No parent manual substitute is authorized.
